Nope!

 

Hippocratic Oath:

Whenever Dr. Medico would deal Damage, prevent that Damage and instead 1 Hero Target regains that much HP.

At the end of your turn, if Dr. Medico is active, up to 3 Targets regain 1 HP each.

 

The real question is what would happen if you stole Jack Handle, and then copied say… Tempest's base power?

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Jackhandle + Squall:

 

You would deal damage to all non-hero targets (Squall), so you choose the first target to be hit, and turn that damage into all target damage.

Then you pick the second target for Squall to hit, and turn that into all non-hero target damage.

Then you pick the third target for Squall to hit. . .

and so on until Squall runs out of targets to aim at.

I actually mark which ones I've aimed at in these cases.

The first time I ran across it was with Writhe's attacka  target, that target attacks all non-hero targets. (Writhe Attacks Fixer, who goes crazy)

 

Similarly Jack Handle you would pick a target for Squall, then Crowbar would hit a second, repeat the same way.
